notes.title: 2nd Demo Update
notes.content: [p]The demo has had some improvements and bug fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Location details now highlight the specific location.[/p][/*][*][p]Menu buttons no longer tremble.[/p][/*][*][p]Issues with pages duplicating and disappearing should be resolved. (This may require starting a new game.)[/p][/*][*][p]Crashes with Alt+Tab in fullscreen should no longer occur.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: - Location details now highlight the specific location.

tags.bug: - Issues with pages duplicating and disappearing should be resolved. (This may require starting a new game.)
- Crashes with Alt+Tab in fullscreen should no longer occur.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[p]There's a new update for the demo available now![/p][list][*][p]There's a new look to parts of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]There's a greater variety to the ambient sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]There is now a way to organize attached pages.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now use the keyboard for more things.[/p][list][*][p]Middle-click / R / C: Attach pages. Repeat to rearrange attached pages.[/p][/*][*][p]Up / Down arrows: Look up / down.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updated controls tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Several bugs have been fixed.
[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: There's a new look to parts of the game.
There's a greater variety to the ambient sounds.
There is now a way to organize attached pages.
You can now use the keyboard for more things.
Middle-click / R / C: Attach pages. Repeat to rearrange attached pages.
Up / Down arrows: Look up / down.
